Lessons.Title: Multiply 2 Two-digit Numbers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will multiply 2 two-digit numbers.
Previously, you used place-value reasoning to decompose a factor in a multiplication expression to multiply numbers up to four-digit by one-digit numbers. In this lesson, you apply these ideas to multiply 2 two-digit numbers. You reason about why it is helpful to decompose both two-digit numbers by place value.
Core relationship: Multiply two two-digit numbers. Distribute both numbers into tens and ones; compute four partial products.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Number Talk: Extra Groups	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Two by Two	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Decompose by Place Value	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  What’s the Product?	 (5 minutes)
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
